name: Li Tieguai; Liu Haichan
material: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink and color on silk
summary: This pair of hanging scrolls show the Daoist immortals Li Tieguai and Liu Haichan.It is said that Li Tieguai’s ethereal self visited the deified Laozi but when he returned, he found that his own body was burned.
